شَمْס

---

*sun*

the star that holds us in orbit / the light we cannot look at directly / what rises regardless of whether we witness it

---

in hebrew: שֶׁמֶשׁ
same root crossing the same desert

ش ม ש
three letters carrying heat across millennia

---

شَمْس is feminine in arabic
but burns without gender
but gives without asking
but

---

    ○
   /|\
  / | \
 /  |  \
dawn    dusk

the scratch between them is a day
the scratch between days is a life

---

شَمْس / שֶׁמֶשׁ / shemesh / shams

we are all saying the same word
for the same fire
in different accents of thirst
